cases.rationale: The case this instrument was built for. The CI reviewer read all 24 new reference files here and reported '0 important, 0 nits'; a scoped follow-up found four real findings. The three targets are where those findings anchor: assertions-and-async.md carries judgment duplicated from unit-testing (the largest of nine such sections), version-discipline.md opens 'Verified against Vitest 4.1.10' with no upstream URL anywhere in 25 files, and SKILL.md carries routing bullets that gesture at facts instead of naming them. running-as-an-agent.md is the false-positive guard: it looks like reproduced upstream documentation but is genuinely absent from vitest.dev, so a reviewer that faults it is over-cutting rather than finding. Targets are paths rather than path:line because the defects are section-scoped and a reviewer may reasonably anchor anywhere within one.
